invariants.description: Delta_P_mus is the clamped sum of two exact first-order responses G_cA u_c (1 - e^(-t/tau_cA)) + G_pA u_p (1 - e^(-t/tau_pA))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Delta_P_mus - np.clip(G_cA*u_c_resp*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_cA)) + G_pA*u_p_resp*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_pA)), Delta_P_mus_min, Delta_P_mus_max))) <= 1e-4*max(1.0, abs(Delta_P_mus_min), abs(Delta_P_mus_max))

invariants.description: Delta_RR_resp is the clamped sum of G_cf u_c (1 - e^(-t/tau_cf)) + G_pf u_p (1 - e^(-t/tau_pf))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Delta_RR_resp - np.clip(G_cf*u_c_resp*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_cf)) + G_pf*u_p_resp*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_pf)), Delta_RR_resp_min, Delta_RR_resp_max))) <= 1e-4*max(1e-3, abs(Delta_RR_resp_min), abs(Delta_RR_resp_max))

bc_sweep.rationale: as for the multiplicative variant: PCO2 excess -1.5..+7.5 mmHg (numerically in Pa with K_c_resp = 1) and chemoreceptor firing -5..+15 spikes/s about nominal.
